scripts.build:android-v3: npm run build:web-v3 && npm run android:build:debug --workspace @esports-live/mobile-v3-native
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name esports-live
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test packages/core/src/*.test.ts packages/adapter-lol/src/*.test.ts packages/adapter-dota2/src/*.test.ts apps/api/src/*.test.ts && node --test services/grubs-cv/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:web-mobile: npm run build:web-mobile && WEB_APP_ROOT=apps/web-mobile playwright test tests/web/mobile- tests/web/completed-board-merge.spec.ts tests/web/live-telemetry-pending.spec.ts
scripts.test:web-v2: npm run build:web-v2 && WEB_APP_ROOT=apps/web-v2 playwright test tests/web/web-v2-
scripts.test:web-v3: npm run build:web-v3 && WEB_APP_ROOT=apps/web-v3 playwright test tests/web/web-v2- tests/web/web-v3-
